title: Curvature-driven spin transport in rank-two string-Carroll hydrodynamics
summary: We derive the rank-two string-Carroll limit of the canonical stress--spin Ward system for probe matter on a fixed torsion-free background. Beyond rank-one Carroll spin hydrodynamics, this retains the coupled Riemann--spin force, a second longitudinal momentum projection, and the longitudinal boost bivector allowed only by a two-dimensional longitudinal kernel. We first extract the term linear in an independent spin amplitude $ς$ and then expand in the near-horizon parameter $λ=ε^2$, avoiding contamination by the omitted $\mathcal{O}(ς^2)$ thermodynamic spin feedback.
